name: PEKAT
recent: Pekat Group Berhad 近期向证券监督委员会提交了转板申请，拟从 ACE Market 转移至主板，并已获得 SC 批准。公司同时宣布以约 RM30.58 million 收购六块位于森美兰的永久工业用地，并延长了私募资金的使用期限。最新季度财报显示营收和净利均实现同比增长。
notable: 获得证券监督委员会批准，从 ACE Market 转板至主板。
间接持股60%的子公司 EPE Switchgear 以 RM30,575,955.32 收购六块永久工业用地。
宣布延长私募资金的使用期限。
risks: 董事 Datin Shelina Binti Razaly Wahi 于2026年10月6日出售20,000股普通股。
首席财务官 Oh Keng Jin 于2026年9月29日出售300,000股普通股。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日的季度，营收为 RM175.434 million，同比增长38.1%，环比增长4.5%；净利为 RM14.194 million，同比增长28.8%，环比增长14.2%；净利率为8.1%，高于上一季度的7.4%。

recent_en: Pekat Group Berhad recently filed for a transfer from the ACE Market to the Main Market and has obtained SC approval. The company also announced the acquisition of six freehold industrial lands in Negeri Sembilan for approximately RM30.58 million and extended the timeframe for utilising its private placement proceeds. The latest quarterly results showed year-on-year growth in both revenue and net profit.
notable_en: Received Securities Commission approval to transfer from the ACE Market to the Main Market.
Indirect 60%-owned subsidiary EPE Switchgear acquired six freehold industrial lands for RM30,575,955.32.
Announced an extension of the timeframe for utilising private placement proceeds.
risks_en: Director Datin Shelina Binti Razaly Wahi disposed of 20,000 ordinary shares on 6 October 2026.
Chief Financial Officer Oh Keng Jin disposed of 300,000 ordinary shares on 29 September 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM175.434 million, up 38.1% year-on-year and 4.5% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was RM14.194 million, up 28.8% year-on-year and 14.2% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 8.1%, higher than 7.4% in the previous quarter.
